C9000174.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 174 (Deterministic construction of strong thin spanning trees.; papers: The strong thin tree conjecture; A polynomial-time construction of strong thin trees; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/174.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_TC_APPLICATION.statement: Verify and quantitatively strengthen the shortcut extraction bridge, conditional on the explicit hierarchy shortcut input; this is not certification of the full thin-tree theorem.

C_TC.statement: The simultaneous response property with 0<=delta<u=1-q/r yields q packed trees at the inclusive resistance threshold alpha*u/(u-delta).

C_TC_COMPACT_CORE.statement: Machine-checked quantified compact threshold consistency at the inclusive endpoint alpha*u/(u-delta), with explicit Brouwer and graph-interface hypotheses.

C_TC_CORE.statement: Universal finite weighted matrix domination, bad-mass counting, packing contradiction, dyadic tail and endpoint-parameter arithmetic.

C_SR.statement: The hierarchy shortcut input yields a single response simultaneously for all positive thresholds with error 16*(r^(-1/4)+1/q)<=40*r^(-1/4).

C_HIER.statement: Exact external polynomial shortcut input thm:hierarchy-power, including local connectivity, marked boundary ratio, positive definiteness, proper-cut constraints and graph-order-independent cutoff.

C_PACKING_PARTITION.statement: Maximal q-tree-packable sets partition vertices monotonically; a nontrivial quotient has strictly fewer than q*(parts-1) crossing edges.

C_BROUWER.statement: Every continuous self-map of a nonempty compact convex subset of a finite-dimensional real vector space has a fixed point.

C_THIN_MAIN.statement: Companion full strong thin-tree theorem; not verified by this bounded extraction mission.

C_SPARSIFICATION.statement: Packing-preserving cut sparsification from the shortcut extraction, auxiliary isotropic representation and MSS signing; outside this mission's verification boundary.

C_ISOTROPIC.statement: Rank-preserving auxiliary isotropic representation with squared norms at most (1+rho)/q; outside this mission's verification boundary.

C_MSS.statement: The independent random-vector MSS bound at (1+sqrt(epsilon))^2; external to this extraction verification.

C_ITERATION.statement: Summability of relative packing loss and cut-factor loss over repeated sparsification; outside this extraction verification.

C_ALGORITHM_MAIN.statement: Full deterministic polynomial-bit strong-thin-tree algorithm, including binary multiplicities; not certified here.

C_CONSTRUCTIVE_EXTRACTION.statement: Polynomial-time rational shortcut extraction with a nearly preserved tree packing and resistance threshold r^(-1/4); not implied by the nonconstructive fixed-point theorem.

C_CONSTRUCTIVE_SIGNING.statement: Deterministic rational rank-one signing with constant 40, using the Ezeunala--Jiang input; outside this extraction mission.
